infobox.usage: Unlocks Room 215 on the second floor of the Pinewood hotel on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pinewood hotel room 215 key (Pnwd 215) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the rooms inside the Pinewood hotel.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Watching You

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Room 215 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Plastic suitcase (locked)
- Loose loot (Provisions, Electronics, Energy elements, Flammable materials)
